actual_owner_views: All eight original frames viewed by W3; no independent all-view pass is implied by this root verdict.
observations: Flow and endings are more varied than the original parallel panels.
Large negative gaps expose too much empty space beneath the lifted hair mass.
Pointed broad lobes and a lifted canopy read as ribbons/tentacles rather than coherent hair.
permitted_use: Retain exact source, shape key, controls and originals as an editable rejected design study.
prohibited_advancement: No isolated GLB carry from this R2 source
next_artist_target: Coherent scalp-to-nape hair mass with continuous roots and no newly enlarged exposed voids.
Tapered secondary locks subordinate to that mass, without broad pointed ribbon lobes or large floating midspans.
Real roughness and strand treatment using the existing reusable material/source pipeline.
Actual textured ordinary-camera, pose/contact and matched LOD review before any runtime-art acceptance.
